explanation:
**To knit a sweater with yarn.**

---

- **毛糸（けいと）** — noun, "knitting yarn, woolen yarn." 毛 (hair/wool) + 糸 (thread). [JLPT N2]
- **セーター** — noun, "sweater." Loanword from English. [JLPT N3]
- **編（あ）む** — 他動詞, "to knit, to weave, to compile." Counterpart 自動詞: 編まれる (passive). Takes を with the product being created. Also used metaphorically: 話を編む (fabricate a story). [JLPT N2]

**To sew a cleaning rag.**

---

- **ぞうきん** — noun, "dust cloth, cleaning rag." Wago. Usually written in hiragana. From 雑巾 (ぞうきん). [JLPT N2]
- **縫（ぬ）う** — 他動詞, "to sew, to stitch." Counterpart 自動詞: 縫われる (passive). Produces: 縫い目 (seam), 縫い物 (sewing). [JLPT N2]

**The clock hand is pointing at 12 o'clock.**

---

- **時計（とけい）の針（はり）** — 時計 = "clock/watch"; 針 = "needle, hand (of a clock)." Note: 針 also means "needle" (sewing) and "stinger." [JLPT N4/N3]
- **指（さ）す** — 他動詞, "to point at, to indicate." Counterpart 自動詞: 指される. In this sentence, the clock hand "points to" a time — an extension of the literal finger-pointing meaning. Also: 方向を指す (point in a direction). [JLPT N2]
- **〜ている** — progressive/state form. Here it describes a continuing state: the hand remains at 12. [JLPT N5]

**To enter this building, you must show identification.**

---

- **このビルに入（はい）るには** — に入る (自動詞, "to enter") + には (purpose conditional). "In order to enter..." [JLPT N4]
- **身分証（みぶんしょう）** — kango noun, "identification card, ID." 身分 (social status/identity) + 証 (proof). [JLPT N2]
- **示（しめ）す** — 他動詞, "to show, to indicate, to demonstrate." Counterpart 自動詞: 示される. More formal than 見せる; implies presenting something as evidence or proof. Noun form: 指示 (しじ, instruction). [JLPT N2]
- **〜なければならない** — obligatory form. "Must, have to." [JLPT N4]

**This river flows into the Pacific Ocean.**

---

- **川（かわ）** — noun, "river." [JLPT N5]
- **太平洋（たいへいよう）** — kango noun, "Pacific Ocean." 太 (great) + 平 (peaceful) + 洋 (ocean). [JLPT N2]
- **注（そそ）ぐ** — 他動詞/自動詞. As 他動詞: "to pour (liquid) into." As 自動詞 (this sentence): "to flow into, to empty into (a larger body of water)." Counterpart pair not applicable (same verb has both uses). Used literally for liquids and metaphorically: 注目を集める (attract attention). Note: different from 注ぐ (そそぐ) meaning "to pour" — same kanji, same reading, both uses. [JLPT N2]

**To rinse the laundry (that was washed with detergent) with water.**

---

- **洗剤（せんざい）** — kango noun, "detergent, soap." 洗 (wash) + 剤 (agent/substance). [JLPT N2]
- **洗（あら）った** — 洗う (他動詞, "to wash"). Past attributive form modifying 洗濯物. [JLPT N5]
- **洗濯物（せんたくもの）** — noun, "laundry, washed clothes." [JLPT N3]
- **水（みず）ですすぐ** — 水 + で (means) + すすぐ. "To rinse with water."
- **すすぐ** — 他動詞, "to rinse." Counterpart 自動詞: すすがれる. Specifically means to rinse off soap/dirt after washing. False friend: Chinese 漱 (shù) means "to gargle," not "to rinse laundry." [JLPT N2]

**It is dangerous to touch a severed power line.**

---

- **切（き）れた** — 切れる (自動詞, "to be cut, to snap, to break"). Counterpart 他動詞: 切る. Past attributive modifying 電線. [JLPT N3]
- **電線（でんせん）** — kango noun, "power line, electric wire." [JLPT N2]
- **触（さわ）る** — 自動詞, "to touch (with hands/fingers)." Takes に for the object touched. Counterpart 他動詞: 触れる (more formal/literary). Note: 触る implies casual/physical contact; often used in warnings. [JLPT N3]
- **〜と危（あぶ）ない** — と (conditional "if") + 危ない (い-adjective, "dangerous"). "If you touch it, it's dangerous." [JLPT N5/N4]

**Please do not touch the exhibits.**

---

- **展示品（てんじひん）** — kango noun, "exhibit, display item." 展示 (exhibition) + 品 (item). [JLPT N2]
- **お手（て）** — お (honorific prefix) + 手 (hand). Polite way to say "your hand" in announcements. [JLPT N5 + honorific]
- **触（ふ）れる** — 自動詞, "to touch, to come into contact with." Takes に for what is touched. Counterpart 他動詞: 触れさせる. More formal than 触る. Also means "to mention (a topic)" — 問題に触れる. [JLPT N2]
- **〜ないでください** — negative request. "Please do not..." [JLPT N5]

**I went abroad to study, harboring big dreams.**

---

- **大（おお）きな夢（ゆめ）を抱（いだ）いて** — 大きな (large, big) + 夢 (dream) + を + 抱いて (て-form of 抱く). "Harboring/carrying big dreams."
- **留学（りゅうがく）した** — 留学する (kango suru-verb, 自動詞, "to study abroad"). Past tense. [JLPT N3]
- **抱（いだ）く** — 他動詞, "to harbor (a feeling/dream/idea), to hold in one's arms." Written as 抱く. Counterpart 自動詞: 抱かれる. Used with abstract objects: 夢を抱く, 疑いを抱く, 期待を抱く. [JLPT N1]

**That person was holding a small child in their arms.**

---

- **腕（うで）に** — 腕 = "arm." に marks the location/position. [JLPT N4]
- **小（ちい）さな子供（こども）** — 小さな (small, little) + 子供 (child). [JLPT N5]
- **抱（かか）えていた** — 抱える (他動詞, "to hold in one's arms, to carry under one's arm, to have on one's hands"). Past progressive. Counterpart 自動詞: 抱えられる. Also used metaphorically: 問題を抱える (to have a problem on one's hands), 借金抱える (to be in debt). [JLPT N2]

**To carry a load on one's shoulder.**

---

- **荷物（にもつ）** — noun, "luggage, load, burden." [JLPT N4]
- **肩（かた）に** — 肩 = "shoulder." に marks the position where the load is placed. [JLPT N3]
- **かつぐ** — 他動詞, "to carry on one's shoulder, to bear on the shoulder." Written 担ぐ. Counterpart 自動詞: 担がれる. Also: 神輿を担ぐ (carry a portable shrine). Note: this is a wago verb, not a kango compound. [JLPT N2]

**To peel off the paper from cookies bought as a gift.**

---

- **プレゼント用（よう）に買（か）った** — プレゼント用 (for a gift) + に (purpose) + 買った (bought, past attributive). [JLPT N4/N5]
- **クッキー** — noun, "cookie." Loanword. [JLPT N4]
- **紙（かみ）をはがす** — 紙 = "paper (wrapping)."
- **剥（はが）す** — 他動詞, "to peel off, to remove (something attached)." Counterpart 自動詞: 剥がれる (はがれる). Used for stickers, wallpaper, paint, wrapping paper. Kanji 剥 also read はぐ in classical contexts. [JLPT N2]

**This painter often paints/draws street scenes.**

---

- **画家（がか）** — kango noun, "painter, artist." 画 (picture) + 家 (specialist). [JLPT N2]
- **街（まち）の風景（ふうけい）** — 街 = "street, town"; 風景 = "scene, landscape, view." [JLPT N3/N2]
- **描（えが）く** — 他動詞, "to draw, to paint, to depict." Counterpart 自動詞: 描かれる. Also used metaphorically: 未来を描く (envision the future), 人物を描く (portray a character). Note: 描く can also be read かかく, but えがく is the standard reading for this verb. [JLPT N2]

**The dropped cup shattered into pieces.**

---

- **落（お）ちた** — 落ちる (自動詞, "to fall, to drop"). Past attributive. Counterpart 他動詞: 落とす. [JLPT N5]
- **こなごなに** — adverb, "into pieces, into smithereens." Onomatopoeic adverb from こな (粉, powder). [JLPT N2]
- **砕（くだ）けた** — 砕ける (自動詞, "to shatter, to break into pieces, to be crushed"). Past tense. Counterpart 他動詞: 砕く (くだく). Used for glass, cups, dreams (metaphorically): 夢が砕ける (dreams shattered). [JLPT N2]

**To crush ice into small pieces and put it in a glass.**

---

- **氷（こおり）を小（ちい）さく砕（くだ）いて** — 氷 (ice) + を + 小さく (adverbial form of 小さい, "small") + 砕いて (て-form of 砕く).
- **グラスに入（い）れる** — グラス (glass, loanword) + に + 入れる (他動詞, "to put in"). Counterpart 自動詞: 入る. [JLPT N5]
- **砕（くだ）く** — 他動詞, "to crush, to smash, to break into pieces." Counterpart 自動詞: 砕ける. Also: 氷を砕く, 骨を砕く (rack one's brains). [JLPT N2]

**The doorway is blocked by luggage.**

---

- **荷物（にもつ）で** — 荷物 = "luggage, baggage." で marks the cause/instrument. [JLPT N4]
- **戸口（とぐち）** — noun, "doorway, entrance." 戸 (door) + 口 (mouth/opening). [JLPT N2]
- **ふさがっている** — ふさがる (自動詞, "to be blocked, to be clogged, to be occupied"). State form (ている). Counterpart 他動詞: ふさぐ. Used for blocked passages, clogged pipes, occupied seats. [JLPT N2]

**To fill a hole in the road with cement.**

---

- **道路（どうろ）の穴（あな）** — 道路 = "road"; 穴 = "hole." [JLPT N3/N4]
- **セメントで** — セメント = "cement." で marks the material/means. [JLPT N3]
- **ふさぐ** — 他動詞, "to block, to fill, to plug, to cover." Counterpart 自動詞: ふさがる. Takes を with the thing being blocked (穴をふさぐ) or に/ga with what is blocking. Used for holes, gaps, mouths (ふさぐ = close mouth). Note: written 塞ぐ. [JLPT N2]

**I walked, avoiding puddles.**

---

- **水たまり** — noun, "puddle, pool of water." 水 (water) + たまり (accumulation, from 溜まり). [JLPT N2]
- **避（さ）けて歩（ある）いた** — 避けて (て-form of 避ける) + 歩いた (past of 歩く). "Avoiding... walked."
- **避（さ）ける** — 他動詞, "to avoid, to evade, to shun." Counterpart 自動詞: 避けられる. Takes を with what is being avoided. Also: 危険を避ける, 衝突を避ける. Noun: 避難 (ひなん, evacuation). [JLPT N3]

**I tried to dodge the incoming ball and ended up falling.**

---

- **飛（と）んでくるボール** — 飛んでくる (coming flying, 飛ぶ + て-form + くる) + ボール (ball). Modifies ボール: "the ball that is coming flying (toward me)." [JLPT N4]
- **よけようとして** — よける (他動詞, "to dodge, to evade, to move out of the way") + よう (volitional) + として (trying to). Counterpart 自動詞: よけられる. Written 避ける or 除ける. Unlike さける (which implies more deliberate/pre-planned avoidance), よける implies a physical dodge in the moment. [JLPT N2]
- **転（ころ）んでしまった** — 転ぶ (自動詞, "to fall, to trip") + てしまった (regret/completion). "Ended up falling (unfortunately)." [JLPT N4]

**The typhoon's path deviated to the north.**

---

- **台風（たいふう）の進路（しんろ）** — 台風 = "typhoon"; 進路 = "course, path, route." 進 (advance) + 路 (road). [JLPT N2]
- **北（きた）にそれた** — 北 (north) + に (direction) + それた (past of それる).
- **それる** — 自動詞, "to deviate, to go off course, to stray." Written 逸れる or 反れる. Takes が with the subject that deviates and に/direction with the direction of deviation. Counterpart 他動詞: そらす. Used for: paths, topics, goals. [JLPT N2]

**Don't change the subject — please answer properly.**

---

- **話（はなし）をそらさないで** — 話 (conversation/topic) + を + そらさないで (negative て-form of そらす). "Don't deflect/evade the topic."
- **ちゃんと答（こた）えてください** — ちゃんと (adverb, "properly, correctly") + 答えてください (please answer). [JLPT N4]
- **そらす** — 他動詞, "to turn aside, to deflect, to divert." Written 逸らす or 反らす. Takes を with what is being diverted. Counterpart 自動詞: それる. Common collocations: 目をそらす (avert one's eyes), 話題をそらす (change the subject), 視線をそらす (divert one's gaze). [JLPT N2]

**The child was staring intently at the mother's photograph.**

---

- **母親（ははおや）の写真（しゃしん）** — 母親 = "mother"; 写真 = "photograph." [JLPT N3/N4]
- **じっと** — adverb, "intently, fixedly, without moving." Often paired with 見る/見つめる. [JLPT N3]
- **見（み）つめていた** — 見つめる (他動詞, "to stare at, to gaze at, to look closely at"). Past progressive. Counterpart 自動詞: 見つめられる. Implies sustained, focused attention — stronger than 見る. Also used abstractly: 将来を見つめる (look to the future). [JLPT N2]

**The mother sat on a bench and watched the children playing.**

---

- **ベンチに座（すわ）って** — ベンチ (bench, loanword) + に + 座って (て-form of 座る, 自動詞, "to sit"). Counterpart 他動詞: 座らせる. [JLPT N5]
- **子どもが遊（あそ）んでいるのを** — 遊んでいる (playing, progressive) + の (nominalizer) + を (object of 眺める).
- **眺（なが）めていた** — 眺める (他動詞, "to gaze at, to look out over, to view (a scene)"). Past progressive. Counterpart 自動詞: 眺められる. Implies a relaxed, contemplative viewing — enjoying a view or watching something from a distance. Noun: 眺め (ながめ, view/scenery). [JLPT N2]

**Seeing the mysterious phenomenon, the two looked at each other's faces.**

---

- **不思議（ふしぎ）な現象（げんしょう）を見（み）て** — 不思議な (mysterious, strange) + 現象 (phenomenon) + を見て (seeing). [JLPT N3/N2]
- **二人（ふたり）は顔（かお）を見（み）合わせた** — 二人 = "two people"; 顔 = "face."
- **見合（みあ）わせる** — 他動詞, "to look at each other, to exchange glances." Compound of 見る + 合わせる. Counterpart 自動詞: 見合わせられる. 顔を見合わせる is a set phrase meaning "to look at each other (in surprise/confusion)." Also means "to postpone/hold off": 結婚を見合わせる. [JLPT N2]

**I saw off my friend who was seeing me to the station.**

---

Note: The sentence seems to have a slightly unusual structure. A more natural reading: "駅まで送ってくれる友人を見送った" = "I saw off the friend who walked me to the station."

---

- **駅（えき）を送（おく）る友人（ゆうじん）** — 駅 (station) + を送る (to walk/escort someone to) + 友人 (friend). The friend escorted the speaker to the station.
- **見送（みおく）った** — 見送る (他動詞, "to see someone off, to watch someone leave"). Past tense. Counterpart 自動詞: 見送られる. Also: 機会を見送る (pass up an opportunity), 成り行きを見送る (watch and wait). [JLPT N2]

**Spring has finally arrived in the northern land.**

---

- **北国（きたぐに）** — noun, "northern region/country." 北 (north) + 国 (country/region). Evokes cold, snowy imagery. [JLPT N2]
- **ようやく** — adverb, "finally, at last." Implies something long-awaited. [JLPT N2]
- **春（はる）が訪（おとず）れた** — 春 = "spring"; 訪れた = past of 訪れる.
- **訪（おとず）れる** — 自動詞, "to visit, to arrive, to come (of a season/time/event)." Counterpart 他動詞: 訪れさせる (rare). Wago reading of 訪れる (also read ほうもんする in kango form). Used for seasons, opportunities, crises "arriving." [JLPT N2]

**Noticing that I had forgotten my commuter pass, I turned back home.**

---

- **定期（ていき）を忘（わす）れたのに気づいて** — 定期 (commuter pass) + を忘れた (forgot) + のに (nominalizer + に) + 気づいて (noticing, て-form of 気づく). 定期 = 定期券 (ていきけん). [JLPT N3/N2]
- **うち** — noun, "home, house." Casual form of 家. [JLPT N5]
- **引（ひ）き返（かえ）した** — 引き返す (自動詞, "to turn back, to return the way one came"). Past tense. Counterpart 他動詞: 引き返させる. Compound of 引き (pull back) + 返す (return). [JLPT N2]

**Winter departed and spring came.**

---

- **冬（ふゆ）が去（さ）って** — 冬 = "winter"; 去って = て-form of 去る.
- **春（はる）になった** — 春 = "spring"; になった = became (past of になる).
- **去（さ）る** — 自動詞, "to leave, to depart, to pass (of time/seasons)." Counterpart 他動詞: 去らせる. Formal/literary register. Used for seasons, people leaving, years passing. Also: 過去を去る (leave the past behind). [JLPT N2]

**To slurp soba noodles noisily.**

---

- **そば** — noun, "soba (buckwheat noodles)." Written 蕎麦 but usually in hiragana. [JLPT N3]
- **音（おと）をたてて** — 音 (sound) + をたてて (making, て-form of 音を立てる set phrase). "Making a sound" = noisily.
- **すする** — 他動詞, "to slurp, to sip, to suck in." Written 啜る. Specifically used for eating noodles with a slurping sound, or sipping hot liquids. In Japan, slurping noodles is culturally acceptable (even encouraged for soba/ramen). [JLPT N2]

**After a long time, I was able to slowly savor the cuisine of my hometown.**

---

- **久（ひさ）しぶりに** — adverb, "for the first time in a while." 久しぶり + に. [JLPT N3]
- **ふるさとの料理（りょうり）** — ふるさと (hometown, 故郷) + の + 料理 (cooking, cuisine). [JLPT N3/N4]
- **ゆっくり** — adverb, "slowly, leisurely, taking one's time." [JLPT N4]
- **味わ（あじわ）うことができた** — 味わう (他動詞, "to taste, to savor, to experience") + ことができた (was able to). Counterpart 自動詞: 味わわれる. Used for both literal taste and metaphorical experience: 苦労を味わう (taste hardship), 成功を味わう (taste success). [JLPT N2]

**The raw garbage stinks.**

---

- **生（なま）ゴミ** — noun, "raw garbage, food waste." 生 (raw/uncooked) + ゴミ (garbage, loanword from ごみ). Specifically refers to kitchen/food waste. [JLPT N2]
- **におう** — 自動詞, "to smell, to give off an odor." Written 匂う. Takes が with the source of the smell. Can be pleasant or unpleasant; context determines. Here, with 生ゴミ, clearly negative. Counterpart 他動詞: 匂わせる (to make something smell / to hint at). Noun: 匂い (におい, smell). [JLPT N2]

**During the war, there was no food and everyone was starving.**

---

- **戦争（せんそう）中（ちゅう）は** — 戦争 = "war"; 中 = "during." [JLPT N4]
- **食（た）べ物（もの）がなく** — 食べ物 (food) + が + なく (negative continuative of ない, = なくて). [JLPT N5]
- **皆（みな）が飢（う）えていた** — 皆 = "everyone."
- **飢（う）える** — 自動詞, "to starve, to hunger." Counterpart 他動詞: 飢えさせる. Written 飢える. Also used metaphorically: 知識に飢える (hungry for knowledge), 愛情に飢える (starving for affection). Takes に for what one hungers for. [JLPT N2]

**I want to question the true feelings of him who said such a thing.**

---

- **あんなことを言（い）った** — あんなこと (such a thing) + を + 言った (said). Past attributive modifying 彼.
- **彼（かれ）の本心（ほんしん）** — 彼 = "he, him"; 本心 = "true feelings, real intention." 本 (true) + 心 (heart/mind). [JLPT N2]
- **問（と）いたい** — 問う (他動詞, "to ask, to question, to inquire"). たい-form (want to). Counterpart 自動詞: 問われる. More formal than 聞く; implies probing or challenging. Also: 責任を問う (hold accountable), 是非を問う (question right/wrong). [JLPT N2]

**The victim described the situation of the incident.**

---

- **被害者（ひがいしゃ）** — kango noun, "victim." 被害 (damage/harm) + 者 (person). [JLPT N2]
- **事件（じけん）の状況（じょうきょう）** — 事件 = "incident, case"; 状況 = "situation, circumstances." [JLPT N3/N2]
- **語（かた）った** — 語る (他動詞, "to tell, to narrate, to speak about"). Past tense. Counterpart 自動詞: 語られる. Implies a detailed, narrative account — not just saying something briefly but telling a story. Noun: 物語 (ものがたり, story). [JLPT N2]

**I resolved in my heart that I would definitely become a doctor in the future and save sick people.**

---

Note: The entry header says 効く (ちかう) but the sentence uses 心に効った — this appears to be a typo in the source. The correct verb is 誓う (ちかう, "to vow, to swear"), not 効く. The kanji in the sentence would be 心に誓った.

---

- **将来（しょうらい）は必（かなら）ず医者（いしゃ）になって** — 将来 (future) + 必ず (definitely) + 医者 (doctor) + になって (becoming, て-form). [JLPT N3/N4/N4]
- **病気（びょうき）の人（ひと）を救（すく）おうと** — 病気の人 (sick people) + を + 救おう (volitional of 救う, "to save/rescue") + と (quotation).
- **心（こころ）に効（ちか）った** — Should be 心に誓った (chikatta, past of 誓う). 誓う (他動詞, "to vow, to swear, to pledge"). Counterpart 自動詞: 誓われる. Takes に with the location of the vow (心に = in one's heart). Noun: 誓い (ちかい, vow). [JLPT N2]

**To walk while supporting one's body with a cane.**

---

Note: The sentence appears garbled in the source. Likely original: 「つえで体を支えて歩く」(To walk while supporting one's body with a cane).

---

- **つえ（杖）** — noun, "cane, walking stick." Written 杖. [JLPT N2]
- **体（からだ）を支（ささ）えて歩（ある）く** — 体 (body) + を支えて (supporting, て-form of 支える) + 歩く (to walk).
- **支（ささ）える** — 他動詞, "to support, to prop up, to sustain." Counterpart 自動詞: 支えられる. Used both literally (physical support) and figuratively: 家族を支える (support one's family), 経済を支える (sustain the economy). Noun: 支え (ささえ, support). [JLPT N2]

**To be chipped, to be lacking, to be insufficient.**

---

Note: No example sentence. The reading should be 欠ける (かける), not just ける.

---

- **欠（か）ける** — 自動詞, "to be chipped, to be missing, to be insufficient." Counterpart 他動詞: 欠く (かく). Two main uses:
  1. Physical: 皿が欠ける (a plate is chipped)
  2. Abstract: 経験が欠ける (lacking experience), 常識に欠ける (lacking common sense)
  Noun: 欠点 (けてん, flaw/weakness). Distinguish from 消える (きえる, to disappear). [JLPT N2]

**To miss, to skip, to leave out, to be without.**

---

Note: No example sentence. Reading is 欠かす (かかす).

---

- **欠（か）かす** — 他動詞, "to miss, to omit, to leave out, to be without." Counterpart 自動詞: 欠ける. Key pattern: 〜を欠かさない (never fail to do/be without). Example: 毎日の練習を欠かさない (never miss daily practice), 挨拶を欠かさない (never fail to greet). [JLPT N2]

**The mountain air is clear.**

---

- **山（やま）の空気（くうき）** — 山 = "mountain"; 空気 = "air." [JLPT N5/N3]
- **澄（す）んでいる** — 澄む (自動詞, "to be clear, to be澄んだ"). State form (ている). Counterpart 他動詞: 澄ます. Used for: air (空気が澄む), water (水が澄む), sky (空が澄む), also emotional states (心が澄む, a clear/pure heart). Noun: 澄み (すみ, clarity). [JLPT N2]

**The muddy river water, clouded by the typhoon, is flowing violently.**

---

- **台風（たいふう）で濁（にご）った川（かわ）の水（みず）** — 台風で (due to the typhoon) + 濁った (muddy/cloudy, past attributive of 濁る) + 川の水 (river water).
- **激（はげ）しく流（なが）れている** — 激しく (violently/fiercely, adverbial) + 流れている (is flowing, progressive of 流れる, 自動詞). [JLPT N2/N3]
- **濁（にご）る** — 自動詞, "to become muddy, to become cloudy, to become unclear." Counterpart 他動詞: 濁す (にごす). Used for: water, voice (声が濁る), sound (音). Also metaphorically: 心が濁る (heart becomes corrupt). [JLPT N2]

**The politician, confronted with a sharp question from a reporter, gave a vague answer.**

---

- **記者（きしゃ）に鋭（するど）い質問（しつもん）をされた** — 記者 (reporter) + に (agent) + 鋭い (sharp, incisive) + 質問をされた (was asked, passive of 質問する). The politician was asked a sharp question. [JLPT N3/N2]
- **政治家（せいじか）** — kango noun, "politician." [JLPT N3]
- **言葉（ことば）を濁（にご）した** — 言葉 (words) + を濁した (muddied/evaded, past of 濁す).
- **濁（にご）す** — 他動詞, "to make vague, to equivocate, to muddy." Counterpart 自動詞: 濁る. 言葉を濁す is a set phrase meaning "to give a vague/evasive answer." Also: 音を濁す (muffle a sound). [JLPT N2]

**To arise, to occur, to be produced.**

---

Note: No example sentence provided.

---

- **生（しょう）じる** — kango suru-verb (also 生じる in wago reading), 自動詞, "to arise, to occur, to be generated." Counterpart 他動詞: 生じさせる. Takes が with what arises. Used for: problems (問題が生じる), changes (変化が生じる), results (結果が生じる). More formal than できる or 起こる. [JLPT N2]

**To reach, to extend to, to be comparable to.**

---

Note: No example sentence provided.

---

- **及（およ）ぶ** — 自動詞, "to reach, to extend to, to be equal to." Takes に/まで for extent. Key patterns:
  - 及びません (cannot compare/falls short)
  - 及び腰 (hem hesitating)
  - 〜に及ぶ (extend to, reach as far as)
  - 考えるに及ばない (no need to think about)
  Counterpart 他動詞: 及ぼす. [JLPT N2]

**Their music had a great influence on young people.**

---

- **彼（かれ）らの音楽（おんがく）は** — 彼ら = "their"; 音楽 = "music." [JLPT N5/N4]
- **若者（わかもの）に大（おお）きな影響（えいきょう）を** — 若者 (young people) + に (target) + 大きな (great, large) + 影響を (influence).
- **及（およ）ぼした** — 及ぼす (他動詞, "to exert, to have (an influence/effect), to cause"). Past tense. Counterpart 自動詞: 及ぶ. Fixed collocation: 影響を及ぼす (have an influence on). Also: 被害を及ぼす (cause damage). [JLPT N2]

**To reach, to arrive at, to lead to.**

---

Note: No example sentence provided.

---

- **至（いた）る** — 自動詞, "to reach, to arrive at, to lead to." Takes に/まで for destination. Key patterns:
  - 〜に至る (lead to, result in)
  - 至る所で (everywhere)
  - 結論に至る (reach a conclusion)
  - 現在に至るまで (up to the present)
  Counterpart 他動詞: 至らせる. [JLPT N2]

**To reach, to attain, to arrive at.**

---

Note: No example sentence. Marked as 自動詞.

---

- **達（たっ）する** — kango suru-verb, 自動詞, "to reach, to attain, to arrive at." Takes に for the goal/destination. Used for: numbers/amounts (100人に達する, reach 100 people), goals (目的を達する), destinations (目的地に達する). More formal than 届く or 着く. Noun: 到達 (とうたつ, arrival/attainment). [JLPT N2]

**To bear fruit, to come to fruition, to ripen.**

---

Note: No example sentence provided.

---

- **実（みの）る** — 自動詞, "to bear fruit, to ripen, to come to fruition." Counterpart 他動詞: 実らせる. Used literally for crops/fruits and metaphorically: 努力が実る (effort bears fruit), 計画が実る (plan comes to fruition). Noun: 実 (み, fruit). [JLPT N2]

**To get dark (of day), to come to an end (of a period), to be busy with.**

---

Note: No example sentence provided.

---

- **暮（く）れる** — 自動詞, "to get dark, to come to an end, to pass (of time)." Counterpart 他動詞: 暮れさせる (rare). Key uses:
  1. Day getting dark: 日が暮れる (night falls)
  2. Year ending: 年末が暮れる (year-end approaches)
  3. Being consumed by: 仕事に暮れる (be absorbed in work)
  Noun: 暮れ (くれ, year-end/dusk), 暮らし (くらし, living/livelihood). [JLPT N3]

**Veteran player A is inferior to player B in physical fitness, but will probably win on technique.**

---

- **ベテランのA選手（せんしゅ）** — ベテラン (veteran, loanword from Dutch/French) + の + A選手 (player A). [JLPT N2]
- **体力（たいりょく）では** — 体力 (physical strength/fitness) + では (in terms of). [JLPT N3]
- **B選手｛に／より｝劣（おと）るが** — B選手 + に (comparison target) or より (comparison marker) + 劣る (is inferior) + が (but).
- **テクニックで勝（か）てるだろう** — テクニック (technique, loanword) + で (in terms of) + 勝てる (can win, potential of 勝つ) + だろう (probably). [JLPT N3]
- **劣（おと）る** — 自動詞, "to be inferior, to fall short, to be less than." Takes に or より for the comparison target. Counterpart 他動詞: 劣らせる. Opposite: 優れる (すぐれる, to be superior). [JLPT N2]

**My opinion differs from that person's.**

---

- **私（わたし）はあの人（ひと）と意見（いけん）が異（こと）なる** — 私 = "I"; あの人 = "that person"; と = "with/from"; 意見 = "opinion"; が異なる = differs.
- **異（こと）なる** — 自動詞, "to differ, to be different, to be distinct." Takes と for what is compared with. Counterpart 他動詞: 異ならせる. More formal than 違う. Adjective: 異なる (ことなる, different — attributive use before nouns). Noun: 異 (こと, difference). [JLPT N2]

**My hair was messed up by the wind.**

---

- **風（かぜ）で髪（かみ）が乱（みだ）れた** — 風で (due to wind) + 髪 (hair) + が乱れた (became disordered, past of 乱れる).
- **乱（みだ）れる** — 自動詞, "to become disordered, to be disturbed, to become chaotic." Counterpart 他動詞: 乱す. Used for: hair (髪が乱れる), breathing (呼吸が乱れる), posture (姿勢が乱れる), discipline (規律が乱れる). [JLPT N2]

**The rookie player disrupted the pace in the second half and ended up losing.**

---

- **新人選手（しんじんせんしゅ）** — kango compound noun, "rookie, new player." 新人 (newcomer) + 選手 (player). [JLPT N3]
- **後半（こうはん）ペースを乱（みだ）して** — 後半 (second half) + ペース (pace, loanword) + を乱して (disrupting, て-form of 乱す).
- **負（ま）けてしまった** — 負ける (自動詞, "to lose") + てしまった (regret/completion). Counterpart 他動詞: 負かす. [JLPT N5]
- **乱（みだ）す** — 他動詞, "to disrupt, to disorder, to disturb." Counterpart 自動詞: 乱れる. Used for: pace (ペースを乱す), order (秩序を乱す), breathing (呼吸を乱す). [JLPT N2]

**To become loose, to slacken, to relax.**

---

Note: No example sentence provided.

---

- **緩（ゆる）む** — 自動詞, "to become loose, to slacken, to relax." Counterpart 他動詞: 緩める. Used for: screws (ネジが緩む), muscles (筋肉が緩む), tension (緊張が緩む), vigilance (気が緩む). Also: 表情が緩む (expression softens). [JLPT N2]

**To loosen, to slacken, to relax (something).**

---

Note: No example sentence provided.

---

- **緩（ゆる）める** — 他動詞, "to loosen, to slacken, to ease." Counterpart 自動詞: 緩む. Used for: screws (ネジを緩める), rules (規制を緩める), pace (ペースを緩める), tension (緊張を緩める). [JLPT N2]

**The bicycle got rusty from being wet in the rain.**

---

- **雨（あめ）にぬれて** — 雨 (rain) + にぬれて (getting wet from, て-form of 濡れる, 自動詞). Counterpart 他動詞: 濡らす. [JLPT N4]
- **自転車（じてんしゃ）がさびてしまった** — 自転車 = "bicycle." さびてしまった = got rusty (past + てしまった for regret).
- **さびる** — 自動詞, "to rust, to corrode." Written 錆びる. Counterpart 他動詞: 錆びさせる (rare). Takes が with what rusts. Noun: 錆（さび, rust). Also metaphorically: 腕が錆びる (skills get rusty from disuse). [JLPT N2]

**Nagano Prefecture does not border the sea.**

---

- **長野県（ながのけん）** — proper noun, "Nagano Prefecture." 県 (prefecture). [JLPT N3]
- **海（うみ）に接（せっ）していない** — 海 (sea/ocean) + に接していない (does not border/adjoin, negative state of 接する).
- **接（せっ）する** — kango suru-verb, 自動詞, "to border on, to adjoin, to come into contact with." Takes に for what is bordered/contacted. Counterpart 他動詞: 接させる. Used for: geography (海に接する, border the sea), contact (人に接する, interact with people), surfaces (面が接する). Noun: 接触 (せっしょく, contact). [JLPT N2]

**Whales belong to the mammal class.**

---

- **クジラ** — noun, "whale." Written 鯨 but usually in katakana. [JLPT N2]
- **哺乳類（ほにゅうるい）に属（ぞく）している** — 哺乳類 (mammals) + に属している (belongs to, state of 属する). 哺乳 = nursing/suckling + 類 = class/category.
- **属（ぞく）する** — kango suru-verb, 自動詞, "to belong to, to be a member of, to be classified under." Takes に for the category/group. Counterpart 他動詞: 属させる. Used for: taxonomic classification, organizational membership. Noun: 所属 (しょぞく, affiliation). [JLPT N2]

**This company's products account for 80% of the market.**

---

- **この会社（かいしゃ）の製品（せいひん）は** — 会社 = "company"; 製品 = "products, manufactured goods." [JLPT N5/N3]
- **市場（しじょう）の8割（わり）を占（し）めている** — 市場 = "market"; 8割 = 80% (8 parts out of 10); を占めている = occupies/account for, state of 占める.
- **占（し）める** — 他動詞, "to occupy, to account for, to hold (a position/proportion)." Counterpart 自動詞: 占められる. Takes を with what is occupied. Used for: market share (市場を占める), positions (重要な位置を占める), proportions (割合を占める). Also: 占領 (せんりょう, occupation). [JLPT N2]

**I am exhausted from working all day.**

---

- **一日中（いちにちじゅう）仕事（しごと）をして** — 一日中 (all day long) + 仕事をして (working, て-form of 仕事する). 一日中 = いちにちじゅう (not いちにちなか). [JLPT N3]
- **くたびれた** — くたびれる (自動詞, "to be exhausted, to be worn out, to be shabby"). Past tense. No counterpart (no direct transitive form). Describes physical exhaustion from prolonged effort. Also describes objects becoming shabby/worn: くたびれたスーツ (a worn-out suit). [JLPT N2]

**This country is blessed with natural resources.**

---

- **この国（くに）は天然資源（てんねんしげん）に恵（めぐ）まれている** — 国 = "country"; 天然資源 = "natural resources" (天然 = natural + 資源 = resources); に恵まれている = is blessed with, passive state of 恵む.
- **恵（めぐ）まれる** — 自動詞 (passive form functioning as adjective), "to be blessed with, to be endowed with." Takes に for what one is blessed with. Active: 恵む (他動詞, "to give charity, to show mercy"). Counterpart: 恵む (active transitive). Used in passive: 才能に恵まれる, 環境に恵まれる. [JLPT N2]

**A hot spring emerged from the land of the house.**

---

- **家（いえ）の土地（とち）から温泉（おんせん）が湧（わ）いた** — 家の土地 (the house's land) + から (from) + 温泉 (hot spring) + が湧いた (emerged/gushed forth, past of 湧く).
- **湧（わ）く** — 自動詞, "to gush forth, to spring up, to emerge, to boil." Takes が/から with the source. Used for: hot springs (温泉が湧く), water (水が湧く), emotions (感動が湧く, feeling wells up), ideas (アイデアが湧く). Counterpart 他動詞: 湧かせる (rare). Distinguish from 沸く (わく, to boil) — same reading, different kanji. [JLPT N2]

**She smiled at me warmly.**

---

- **彼女（かのじょ）は私（わたし）に** — 彼女 = "she"; 私 = "me"; に marks the target of the smile.
- **にっこりと** — adverb (onomatopoeic), "with a warm smile, beamingly." にっこり + と. Often paired with ほほえむ/笑う. [JLPT N2]
- **ほほえんだ** — ほほえむ (自動詞, "to smile"). Past tense. Takes に for the target. Written 微笑む. Counterpart 他動詞: ほほえみかける. More literary/poetic than 笑う（わらう）. Implies a gentle, warm smile. Noun: 微笑（ほほえみ/びしょう, smile). [JLPT N2]

**My younger sibling is good at making people laugh by fooling around.**

---

- **弟（おとうと）は** — 弟 = "younger brother." [JLPT N5]
- **ふざけて人（ひと）を笑（わら）わせるのが得意（とくい）だ** — ふざけて (fooling around, て-form of ふざける) + 人を笑わせる (making people laugh, causative of 笑う) + のが得意だ (is good at).
- **ふざける** — 自動詞, "to fool around, to joke, to mess around." Takes が with the subject. No standard transitive counterpart. 笑わせる = 笑う (to laugh) + せる (causative) = "make (someone) laugh." 得意だ = "good at, skilled in." [JLPT N2]

**It is too late to regret things that have already happened.**

---

- **過（す）ぎたこと** — 過ぎた (past, gone, past attributive of 過ぎる, "to pass") + こと (things). "Things that have passed." [JLPT N4]
- **今（いま）さら** — adverb, "now, at this late stage." Implies it's too late to do something about it. [JLPT N2]
- **悔（くや）んでも遅（おそ）い** — 悔やんでも (even if you regret, て-form + も) + 遅い (is too late).
- **悔（くや）む** — 他動詞, "to regret, to lament, to grieve." Counterpart 自動詞: 悔やまれる. Takes を with what is regretted. Stronger than 後悔する — implies deep sorrow/lamentation. Noun: 悔やみ (くやみ, grief/regret). [JLPT N2]

**While I was hesitating to apply, the deadline passed.**

---

- **申（もう）し込（こ）みをためらっているうちに** — 申し込み (application) + をためらっている (hesitating about, progressive of ためらう) + うちに (while, during the time that). [JLPT N2]
- **締（し）め切（き）りが過（す）ぎてしまった** — 締め切り (deadline) + が過ぎてしまった (passed, past of 過ぎる + てしまった for regret). 締め切り = 締め切る (close) + nominalized. [JLPT N2]
- **ためらう** — 自動詞, "to hesitate, to waver, to be reluctant." Takes を with the action one is hesitating about, or が with the subject. Counterpart 他動詞: ためらわせる. Similar to 迷う (まよう) but ためらう implies more emotional hesitation. [JLPT N2]

**To revere gods and Buddhas.**

---

- **神仏（しんぶつ）** — kango noun, "gods and Buddhas, deities." 神 (kami/Shinto gods) + 仏 (Buddha/Buddhist deities). Represents both Shinto and Buddhist traditions in Japan. [JLPT N1]
- **敬（うやま）う** — 他動詞, "to revere, to respect, to venerate." Counterpart 自動詞: 敬われる. Takes を with the object of reverence. Formal/literary register. More intense than 尊敬する. Used for: gods, elders, authority. Noun: 敬意 (けいい, respect). Related: うやうやしく (reverently). [JLPT N1]
